title: rangeSlider widget value round issue on Safari
body:
First things first: THX a ton for all your awesome work w/ instantsearch.js 👍

Seems there is an issue w/ the `rangeSlider`widget - only on Safari, so far tested on OS X only.

![](https://owc-dropshare.s3-eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/2016-09-02_11-18-27-vWoRlQCPKr.png)

To reproduce: https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/documentation/#rangeslider
